text:
Alex: Heads-up — payments team flagged account acct_9123 for high card velocity: 27 auth attempts in 10 min, 8 successful charges. Risk Bot alerted and we auto-hold billing. Anyone grabbing details?

Risk Bot: Automated: [ALERT] HIGH_VELOCITY_CARD detected for account acct_9123. Score: 0.92. Actions taken: billing_hold=true, created dispute-thread-1772145600. Links: <https://internal.redwood/risk/alerts/1772145600>.

Maria: On it. Can you paste the txn IDs and last 4 digits? I'll pull processor logs.

Alex: Txns: txn_77821 txn_77822 txn_77823 txn_77824. Cards ending 4242/8431/3714. IPs: 34.89.123.12, 13.52.11.7, 34.89.123.12 (repeat). Looks botty.

Ben: @Maria I'll export the CSV from the gateway in 5m. Also need customer support chat logs — they've disputed two charges already.

Sarah: We should prepare dispute evidence pack. Need: full transaction receipts, order IPs, device fingerprint, AVS/CVV results, customer signed T&Cs, support transcript. @Kevin can you confirm if refunds automatically went through?

Kevin: Refunds not yet issued — system blocked refunds while hold active. We should not refund until we determine unauthorized vs fraud ring. Suggest issuing temporary credit if they force close.

Maria: I pulled processor logs — `status: captured` for txn_77821-23, `manual_review` for 77824. AVS mismatch for 77823. CVV passed for 77821/22, failed for 77823.

Billing Bot: Notice: Manual hold placed on acct_9123 by system at 1772145600. Billing invoices paused. To release hold, escalate to finance@redwood.com with evidence.

Alex: I'm drafting a short memo for legal. Quick ask: has the customer provided a chargeback/DM? Support thread shows "unauthorized charges" at 2026-02-27 13:04. We need to respond to card network within 7 days.

Ben: Export ready. Uploading receipts & logs to secure drive: https://internal.redwood/secure/flows/packet-9123 (SAML req). Tagging #legal and #ops.

Sarah: @Alex add statement about pattern (same IP repeat, multiple BINs, multiple cards) and request provisional refund hold. I'll assemble fight package.

Maria: Also export device_fingerprint hash list. Example: `fp: e4b0a1f9c2d3...`

Kevin: Recommend we also request email verification headers and any geo mismatch. If bank disputes, we need AVS/CVV screenshots and merchant descriptor.

Alex: OK. I'll send to legal now. If legal calls for immediate refund, we can issue partial refund for disputed txns only. Keep thread updated.

Julia Ramos: Received. Case L-2026-089 created. I'll review evidence. Please add customer communications, signed subscription agreement, and full 7-day timeline.

Ben: Uploaded everything. Confirmed links: receipts, logs, support transcript. Also attached raw IP netblocks and device hashes.

Maria: One more thing — risk model flagged user agent strings `Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1)` repeated. Looks like scraping tools.

Alex: Thanks all. If we end up losing dispute, we'll need to credit and maybe block associated devices. I'll update once Legal responds.
